# temps_analytics_goal (Resource)

A conversion goal of a project's analytics: a custom event (`event`) or a page view (`page`) that counts as a conversion, optionally carrying revenue.

Import with `<project_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `analytics:read`, `analytics:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_analytics_goal" "upgrade" {
  project_id       = temps_project.web.id
  name             = "Upgrade to Pro"
  kind             = "event"
  event_name       = "plan_upgraded"
  event_filter     = jsonencode([{ type = "custom_data", value = { path = "plan", value = "pro" } }])
  revenue_property = "amount"
  revenue_currency = "EUR"
}

resource "temps_analytics_goal" "thank_you" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  name       = "Reached thank-you page"
  kind       = "page"
  page_path  = "/thank-you"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) What counts as a conversion. One of `event`, `page`.
- `name` (String) Name of the goal, unique in the project.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `event_filter` (String) Conditions a conversion must meet, as in funnel steps: `jsonencode([{ type = "custom_data", value = { path = "plan", value = "pro" } }])`. Temps applies them to page goals too; unset has no conditions. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `event_name` (String) Custom event that converts (`event`).
- `page_path` (String) Page path that converts (`page`), for example `/thank-you`.
- `revenue_currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency of the revenue, in capitals (`EUR`).
- `revenue_property` (String) Event property holding the conversion's revenue.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_analytics_goal.upgrade 8/5
```
